text:
maya: quick design check — noticed a keyboard focus regression when toggling sampling while using the time-range scrubber. tab to the timepicker, use arrow keys to nudge, then hit the sampling toggle — focus disappears and VO says 'button lost'. link to screen recording: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/abcd :eyes:
jon: can repro on latest canary. root cause looks like we unmount/mount the whole sampling panel which moves focus. simple fix is to keep DOM node and toggle a class instead of remounting. also add `aria-pressed` for the toggle so screen readers announce state.
sam: a11y nit — the tooltip currently says `Rate` which is ambiguous. VoiceOver reads it as "Rate button". Suggest full label: `Sampling rate (percentage of requests)` and add `aria-describedby` pointing to helper text.
elena: microcopy suggestion: rename `Auto-sample` -> `Adaptive sampling` and helper text: `Reduces query volume; may omit rare slow tails`. short and explicit. :bulb:
reza: small perf note — when sampling toggles we also re-render the heatmap overlay which forces layout thrash. Instead animate opacity on the overlay so browser can do GPU compositing. that avoids the ~30ms jank I'm seeing on 1000 rps test.
maya: good call. also the p95 selection range gets lost when sampling changes — we should persist the selection (store in state) and reapply after toggle.
jon: putting a tiny CSS example here for focus so we don't remove default outline for keyboard users:
```css
.focus-visible:focus {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(0,116,217,0.85);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,116,217,0.12);
}
```
sam: for VO strings I'll add: `Sampling toggle, current state: on` and `Sampling rate control, percent` — and ensure the slider has `aria-valuetext` with percent.
elena: design question — where should the sampling control live on narrow screens? inline with timepicker or in the overflow menu? my vote is overflow to avoid crowding. thoughts?
reza: overflow seems fine but keep a visible affordance in collapsed state (icon + tooltip) so users know it's there. keyboard should still tab into it in the normal tab order.
designbot: preview deploy created for this patch: https://staging.redwood.com/pull/432 — includes persistent DOM approach and updated labels. CI passed :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks everyone. owners: jon (focus + e2e), sam (VO strings), elena (copy + mobile placement), reza (overlay perf). I'll open a parent ticket linking prs. final checks: make sure p95 brush persists after sampling toggle and that tab order is preserved (no focus loss). :a11y: :thumbsup:
jon: i'll add an e2e test: `timepicker -> nudge -> toggle sampling -> ensure focus on toggle and p95 brush intact`.
sam: i'll run a quick NVDA/VO pass after PR lands.
maya: great — will follow up in the ticket with a small checklist. closing the thread for async work. thanks! :pray:
